title: Pilaaruuji toowɗi ɗi henndu ɓuuɓndu
intro: Miijo-ɗee siwil en ƴellitiiɓe, dokkaaɓe semmbe toowɗo e karallaagal mahngo ngal alaa ko nanndi e mum. Koɗnooɗo hakkunde duuɗe jaajɗe, ɓutte, ndee renndo umminii maandeeji mawɗi memi asamaan. Kono mawnikinaare ƴettii ƴiiƴam, noddaango ngam hootde e dewal Alla tan hawri e ƴattooje. Ko rewi heen ko heddii ko jeertinaango jolngo e henndu nduu e hoore mum.
clues: En ngonnoo leñol doolewol garngol caggal leñol Nuuhu, barkinngol darnde e doole mawɗe.
Min mahii cuuɗi toowɗi e monimaaji e kala nokku toowɗo ngam fijirde tan e mawnikinaare.
Min manti, min mbiyi hol ɓurɗo min semmbe, min mbaɗi ko tiiɗnaare tawa min yurmaaki.
En caliima nulaaɗo men Huudu nde o noddi en ndewen Alla tan, o noddi mbo losɗo, penoowo.
En njaltinii jeertinaango ngoo, en ndartinii mo yo o addan en jukkungo ngo o hulɓini so tawii ko goonga.
Min mbonnaama e henndu tikkere, ɓuuɓndu, jammaaji jeeɗiɗi e balɗe jeetati, min keddii ina njippii no ɓuuɓri leɗɗe palɗe nii.

arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَأْفِكَنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful." (46:22)
